speaker: penny
text: What's up with Ichabod?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh he's trying to make a new friend.

speaker: penny
text: Oh really? Well, good for him.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Well, unless he's makes one out of wood like Gepetto, I don't think it's gonna happen.

speaker: penny
text: Well, how did you guys become friends?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: There was a flier on the bulletin board at the university. Roommate wanted. Whistlers need not apply.

speaker: penny
text: And you moved in anyway?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I assumed he was joking. You'd be surprised how many particle physicists have a whimsical side.

speaker: penny
text: Well, what about Howard and Raj, I mean how did you become friends with them?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I don't know, how do carbon atoms form a benzene ring? Proximity and valence electrons.

speaker: penny
text: Well yeah, sure. When you put it that way. But it all worked out, right?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I suppose. I do miss whistling though.

speaker: penny
text: Oh come on, really?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: First warning.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Penny Penny Penny.This is for you.

speaker: penny
text: Hello Sheldon.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Hi.

speaker: penny
text: What is this?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: It's a questionnaire I devised. I'm having some difficulty bonding with a colleague at work, so I'm doing a little research to better understand why my current friends like me.

speaker: penny
text: Yes. Well, that is a good question. But is this really the best way to figure it out?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Yeah, I agree, the social sciences are largely hokum. But, short of putting electrodes in your brain and monitoring your response to my companionship, this is the best I can do.

speaker: penny
text: Okay, question 1. Rank the following aspects of Sheldon Cooper in order of appeal. Intelligence. Ruthless attention to hygiene. Playfulness. Java applet writing?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I know, I may have started off with a fairly obvious one. You did an aspect of my most appealing trait, playfulness. Why don't you just go ahead and write that number 1. I'm afraid you're on your own for the rest. It should take you no more than 3 hours.

speaker: penny
text: Wait! How many questions are on this thing?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Only 211. Don't worry, in deference to you, I've kept them on a high school graduate reading level.

speaker: penny
text: Thanks pal.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You got it, buddy.

speaker: penny
text: Sheldon honey, did you ever consider making friends by being, I don't know, pleasant?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well that's certainly a thought-provoking hypothesis. May I suggest it as the topic for your essay.
